about.title: What's the Ugrow?
about.description: The Ugrows is an academic project by Guilherme Veiga Pedromilo through ICETI - Cesumar Technology and Innovate Institute. Through a multi-platform desktop application, users will be able to manage their debts in an organized and simple manner, while also learning more about financial education through digital content and educational materials provided within the application.
